sections.heading: Style-120 Raymarched Fractal Landscapes — 3 s silent preview

children.value:
Subject: an idea becomes a connected system. 1280x720, 30 fps, 3 s, silent.
Renderers: Three.js + GLSL + Offscreen Rendering — Three.js fullscreen-quad GLSL raymarcher -> WebGLRenderTarget (0.6 scale) -> linear blit (ACES + sRGB once).
Motion owner: GSAP — one paused GSAP timeline (

) tweens uniforms + camera; each update/hf-seek renders synchronously, no accumulation.
Palette: background #080A0C (exact on all missed/fogged pixels), foreground #F2EEE5 (copy, material albedo, emissive).

rows.Beat: A small idea spark lights above the dark fog; kicker "AN IDEA BECOMES" fades in (0.25–0.95).
uEmerge: fog density 0.62 -> 0.075 and fractal power 3 -> 8; the central Mandelbulb and two satellites emerge with reflections on a mirror floor. Camera dollies (0.9,0.62,8.4) -> (0,0.2,5.6).
Emissive links draw from the core to each satellite (connected system).
uLandscape 0 -> 0.35: smooth-min blend toward a domain-repeated pyramid fold rising away from the solids.

children.value: Not in preview: full landscape, sunset, SDF glyph lettering (planned: glyph distance texture extruded with max(d2D, |z|-h)).
